Actual finite-field Gauss--Jacobi convolution and the seventh-root fiber law are proved from an order-seven character. The exact affine count of z^7=x(1-x) includes zero and every diagonal Jacobi sum, with no assumed fiber law.

Actual diagonal Jacobi sums discharge the orbit-invariance hypothesis. Their full polynomial and every signed power trace compress, and the actual compensated G2 source packet satisfies the same factorization after its complete native rescaling. Rational-prime descent is not asserted.
